Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! Hey, Ferb! (Throws pillow at Ferb) It's Candace's birthday! We gotta do better than last year.

Name: Gorilla
Dialog: (Comes out cake; Roars)

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! (Slams door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not our best work. This time it's gotta be something huge!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is yours, I believe.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Happy birthday, Candace! I made you a special breakfast! (Shows a pile of pancakes with a birthday candle on top)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And after that, we have a surprise!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it?! Where is it?!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: We have to drive to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Ooooooooooh!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Is it the mall?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay... (looks around) but is it the mall, right?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (offscreen) No, it's not the mall!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Please don't tell me we're going to Mt. Rushmore...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isn't it great? (Looks at a pamphlet) Four American presidents carved into a side of a mountain.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It was Phineas and Ferb's idea!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're welcome.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay. You lot go on ahead. I'll find a parking spot and meet you there! (drives off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going up to the monument. Come on, Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, we'll join you in a minute!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, Candace. It's your birthday, you can pick out anything you want. Ooh, what about the Mt. Rushmore bobble head?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, that's lame.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. How about this cute, cuddly Lincoln?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (Runs to counter) Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, I'm just here on the Mr. Slushy Burger worker exchange program.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um... (Clattering) Uh, oh, well, it's my birthday today, and...I...uh... (Clattering) I gotta check something. Back in a flash, 'kay? (Zips off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Deeply) Where'd they go?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Fletcher.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella. What brings you girls here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Fireside Girls field trip. Um, is Phineas here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mmm hmm. He and Ferb are up on the monument.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Possibilities.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Ding)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to no good again. We just discovered his new hideout is located inside Lincoln's head at Mt. Rushmore. (Perry scowls) I-I know. You were just there. Poor planning on our part, actually. Sorry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growling voice) Phineas?! Ferrrrb?! Ohh.

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, honey. What are them kids doing up on the monument?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see that. (Looks through the binoculars, sees Phineas and Ferb on the monument and gasps) Mom! Mom, you've got to see this now. Here, look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oop. Ran out of time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, (Rummaging) here, look now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Old Reliable Geyser. How exciting! (at Candace) I'm just gonna go back to the gift shop.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! Your timing﻿ is impeccable. And by impeccable I mean

Name: So, as they say in China
Dialog: Arrivederci!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, where should we start?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Hi, Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a surprise.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could use a lookout!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You got it!

Name: Cashier
Dialog: Uh, ma'am, if you handle the big stick, you gotta buy it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Ranger
Dialog: (On megaphone) Uh, excuse me. Aren't you a little young to be restoring a national monument?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Holds megaphone)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On megaphone) Yes. Yes we are.

Name: Ranger
Dialog: Well, it's good to see young people taking an interest in our national heritage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Grunting and screaming)

Name: Computer Voice
Dialog: Hull overheating. Hull overheating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The molten lava of the earth's core completely slipped my mind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! THE LAVA IS FOLLOWING US!!!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The lava is being diverted. You did it, Perry the Platypus! You saved us!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I hate to be a stickler, but the lava is coming AGAIN!!! FASTER!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait 'till you see what those two are up to!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (singsong) She's coming!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: They're getting closer!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're running a little behind on schedule. Go to Plan B.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on bullhorn) Plan B, girls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You are gonna be shocked by what I'm about to show you, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. I guess things look better in photos. (Phone rings) Oh, it's Dad. (walks away)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hi, honey! I found an absolutely brilliant parking space!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Going down the stairs) Great! I'll meet you at the gift shop, Dear. I still have to buy that big stick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (long pause) Oops.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (tears up, sobs) Why it's... (sobs) i-it's...IIIIIT'S BEAUUUUTIFULLLL...! (sobs) MOOOOOM!!! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (trips) I've gotta show you something right now! (drags her) Come on! Follow me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, are you still trying to get the boys in trouble?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No, no, this is a great thing! Oh, it's the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (tries to climb the stairs) You know, Candace, this is the second time I've climbed up there! I'm already down half a dress size!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! Hurry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, where are you going? AAH! (The Drill-inator lands on the geyser) I'm okay, I -- (spins around and gets flung away) AAH! Fie upon you, Perry the Platypuuuuus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom! You won't believe it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...Huh?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Ewwwww!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whew! Finally made it, honey! Now, what is it you wanted me to see?

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're right! It's beautiful! (hugs her) Happy birthday, honey. (Kisses Candace's cheek) Now let's go find your father.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! (bangs her head on the iron rod)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did ya like your birthday present?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh, uh... (walks away)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, it was definitely better than the gorilla in the cake.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (comes over with a gift box) Hey, Candace! I had a break, and I, uh, I thought I'd give you this for you birthday. (Gives her the box, she opens it) I saw you looking at it in the gift shop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A Mt. Rushmore bobble head.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Eh -- You like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dreamly) Oh! I absolutely love it...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great. I gotta get back. Happy birthday! (walks away waving)

Name: Candace
Dialog: This was the best birthday ever! (walks away)
